name: Color Treated Hair
description: Color treated hair refers to hair that has undergone coloring processes such as dyeing, highlighting, or bleaching. This can cause changes in the hair's structure and appearance, affecting its overall health.
causes: Exposure to sunlight and environmental factors
symptoms: Color fading or uneven color distribution
risk_factors: Use of harsh chemicals during treatment
ingredients_to_avoid: Strong acids or alkalis in hair products

daily_routine.purpose: To gently cleanse without stripping natural oils

daily_routine.step: Apply a hydrating conditioner or mask
daily_routine.purpose: To nourish and moisturize the hair

lifestyle_tips: Limit heat styling and chemical processing
Protect hair from sunlight with a hat or UV spray
Eat a balanced diet rich in vitamins and minerals
common_myths: Hair color treatments permanently damage hair.
Color-treated hair requires harsher care products.
when_to_consult_doctor: If severe dryness, brittleness, or breakage persists despite proper care routines.
prevention: Regular use of hydrating and nourishing products

severity_levels.mild: Dryness and slight color fading; manageable with regular moisturizing routines.
severity_levels.moderate: Increased dryness, brittleness, and noticeable color changes; requires more intensive care measures.
severity_levels.severe: Severe dryness, frequent breakage, and significant loss of hair color; professional treatment recommended.

expert_tips: Regular trims to remove split ends
